natural_body: Price-sensitive SMB 40% off: signups +31%, revenue +18%, retention -12%; renewals weak.

first.rationale: Simplifying onboarding directly addresses the 4% completion decline and has prior evidence of improving activation and early adoption. Verifying memories 86 and 31 will test the consistency and durability of that evidence. Promotional pricing could counter the competitor, but memory 73 indicates weaker retention and renewals, conflicting with sustainable long-term qualified revenue.
